title: Whistle
description: Create a class named `Whistle`. Add the variable `private String sound` to the class. After that, create the constructor `public Whistle(String whistleSound)`, which is used to create a new whistle that's given a sound.

paragraphs: Create a class named `Whistle`. Add the variable `private String sound` to the class. After that, create the constructor `public Whistle(String whistleSound)`, which is used to create a new whistle that's given a sound.
Then create the method `public void sound()` that prints the whistle's sound.
